pause.title: Operation
pause.description: An entity of your own can pause the comfort movements, for example a helper you turn on for a party or while you are away. While it is on, comfort movements wait as if the switch "Pause" were on; protection and the fire alarm still move the shutters. If the entity is unavailable or its state is unknown, comfort movements wait too, and after an hour a repair issue says so.

pause_source.label: Pause entity
pause_source.description: While this entity is on, comfort movements are paused. With "None", only the switch "Pause" pauses. A pause entity of the house or of a group always applies to its windows as well.
